changes: The reviewed build may also be redistributed as a GitHub Release download bundle (OD-19).
Common names people type (COVID-19, HIV, 猴痘) are mapped to the manual's own wording by a packaged alias table (OD-16).

reviewer_note: AI review delegated by the owner for the source, layout and content gates of the specimen manual; not reviewed by a person. By the owner's decision, query results carry no note saying so.

CDC-R1-SOURCE.purpose: Both raw artifacts are the specimen manual and its revision table attached to the official CDC page.
checklist: The landing page is https://www.cdc.gov.tw/Category/Page/WV_GRwCIYrWQsEVa8ctTWg on www.cdc.gov.tw over HTTPS.
Exactly one attachment is labelled 衛生福利部疾病管制署傳染病檢體採檢手冊-<7-digit version>版.pdf and exactly one 傳染病檢體採檢手冊修訂對照表-<same version>.pdf; each viewer page points at one /Uploads/*.pdf on www.cdc.gov.tw.
Both files start with %PDF- and end with %%EOF; fetch.json is canonical and its sizes and SHA-256 match both stored PDFs.
Every chapter 2 table page header prints the attachment version as 版次 and one 核准日期.
Attribution names 衛生福利部疾病管制署, the manual title, the version and the CDC open data declaration URL; the service is described as not official and not endorsed by CDC.

CDC-R1-LAYOUT.purpose: Every chapter 2 row is rebuilt from the PDF layout with each cell in its own column.
checklist: pypdfium2 and PDFium equal the packaged qualifier spec pdfium-layout-v1; no OCR is used.
Columns follow the header text (8 or 7 columns); a page without a header continues only when every column width matches the previous page.
Rows end at black rules that reach both column edges; red revision underlines never split a row.
Text overflowing onto the next page joins the same cell on the previous page; every row sharing that cell gets the full text.
Before the pointer switches, every cell of every row is compared with the Word table tag text of the same PDF.
The curated database holds every row once with its PDF page, printed page, section, row box, raw cell text, display text and row hash.

CDC-R1-CONTENT.purpose: Each served row keeps the meaning of the official manual.
checklist: Disease, specimen, purpose, collection time, volume, transport, 應保存種類（應保存時間） and notes stay in the same row as printed.
應保存種類（應保存時間） is shown under its official name and results carry not_pre_submission_storage=true; transport temperatures stay in 送驗方式 or the notes.
Different specimens, purposes or collection times of one disease are never merged into one disease-level rule.

Display text only joins lines that wrapped at the column edge and keeps numbered items on their own lines; it adds or removes no characters other than line breaks and one space between letters or digits.
Results give no advice on diagnosis, claims or purchasing.
The packaged alias table only decides which wording is searched; answers keep the manual's own disease names, and its version is part of the build fingerprint (OD-16).

PUB-R1-OWNER.purpose: The build may be served by the local MCP runtime and redistributed as a GitHub Release download bundle.
checklist: Only an installed distribution may publish.
Every official result carries provenance attribution, the manual version and the note 非疾管署官方服務，內容以疾管署公告為準。
Review records and golden cases name the reviewer as ai-reviewer:claude-opus-5, never as a person or as the owner.
Download bundles contain only the raw revision and the curated build with its audit folder (docs/adr/0004-cdc-snapshot-release-bundle.md).

required_coverage: a disease with several specimen rows
a value shared from a merged cell
text that continues onto the next page
a seven-column row without 應保存種類（應保存時間）
a cell whose display text joins wrapped lines
golden_cases.comparison: Compare each expected raw or display value, the locator and the row hash with the rows read from the manual PDF, and check that the input disease matches the row's disease name.
